Table 3: Detailed settings of all evaluated methods.

Figure 4: Overview of SFS. Adapted from Light et al. (2025). SFS builds on MCTS and incorporates techniques such as careful seed initialization and textual optimization. SCATTERING diversifies refinements via dynamic prompt variation, FORESTING provides multiple starting codes for MCTS, and SCOUTING propagates insights about textual directions across the search process.

Figure 3: Overview of the problem formulation. Adapted from Light et al. (2025). Given a prompt p, an LLM iteratively generates and refines codes c on the basis of feedback from validation tests V. The objective is to generate a code ctrue that passes all hidden tests H.
